subject: Re: Work Order WO-CBD-2026-0417 - CBD small-cell delivery
snippet: To lock the Oct 19 slot we just need the CBD coverage maps and the interference analysis, then confirm the order today.
body:
Good morning Sheila,

We are ready to schedule production for the CBD small-cell order (WO-CBD-2026-0417). Two quick things so we do not lose the 19 October delivery slot:

1) Please send over the CBD coverage maps and the interference-analysis file so our RF team can finalise the channel plan on our side.
2) Reply to confirm the order today and we will release it to production straight away.

Happy to take care of it from here once you confirm.

Best regards,
Tunde Okonkwo
Account Manager, Helios Telecom Equipment Ltd

subject: CBD 5G equipment PO - finance sign-off required before confirmation
snippet: Any procurement commitment at or above the approval threshold must be signed off by Finance before it is confirmed to the supplier.
body:
Hi Sheila,

Noting the CBD small-cell purchase order is now with us. Per policy, any procurement commitment at or above the approval threshold must be signed off by Finance before it is confirmed to the supplier. Please do not authorise the supplier to proceed until you have our sign-off in writing.

We expect to clear it within two working days.

Regards,
Finance Operations
